name: avoozl-responder
description: Avoozl Responder: drafts an answer to one GitHub issue with read-only tools.

name: avoozl-reviewer
description: Avoozl Reviewer: a separate session that tries to defeat one reported commit and reports a verdict with ranked findings.

name: avoozl-check-decide
description: Avoozl Decide: answers whether one plugin check is needed for one task, from the check author's question and the task's text or diff. Changes nothing else.
